end.summary:
Reviewed the difference between an organ and an organ system using heart, stomach, intestines, and circulatory system examples.
Practised ordering cell → tissue → organ → organ system → organism; 3 of 5 ordering attempts were unaided correct.
Practised examples of levels in humans and plants; 1 unaided example attempt was correct.
Discussed Amoeba as a single-celled organism without tissues or organs. Teach-back was not yet passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised the hierarchy from cell to organism and used the “parts joining to make a team” method to clarify organ versus organ system. Yash corrected the initial heart-versus-system mix-up by identifying the heart as an organ and the circulatory system as an organ system. At home, they can make a five-step arrow diagram and add one human and one plant example at each step.
